records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales from the Retail segment accounted for approximately 85.4% of consolidated net sales for the six months ended July 31, 2025, compared to 88.5% for the comparable period in fiscal 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Comparable store net sales increased as a result of higher store traffic, transactions, average unit retail and conversion rate, while units per transaction decreased.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total inventory at July 31, 2025, as compared to July 31, 2024, increased by $91.5 million, or 15.1%, to $696.2 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses increased by $43.6 million, or 12.5%, in the second quarter of fiscal 2026, compared to the second quarter of fiscal 2025.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Income from operations was 11.6% of net sales, or $174.4 million, for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 compared to 10.7% of net sales, or $145.1 million, for the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
